answer.because: The script's entry logic does not follow the golden strategy description; it disarms on an opposite-color candle instead of price returning to the POC zone, uses consecutive candles instead of a pivot for confirmation, and lacks the mandatory reversal trade after a stop-out.
answer.script:
//@version=5
strategy("Delta Volume Breakout Night Shift", overlay=true,
  initial_capital=50000, default_qty_type=strategy.fixed, default_qty_value=1,
  commission_type=strategy.commission.cash_per_contract, commission_value=5.50,
  slippage=1, pyramiding=0, process_orders_on_close=false, calc_on_every_tick=true,
  max_bars_back=5000)
// ===== RISK =====
pv                = input.float(2, "Point Value ($)")
stop_dollars      = input.int(250, "Stop ($)", minval=250, maxval=1500)
tp_dollars        = input.int(500, "Take Profit ($)", minval=250, maxval=2000)
use_trail         = input.bool(false, "Enable Trailing Stop")
trail_step_amt    = input.int(500, "Trail: Tighten every ($)", minval=0, maxval=2000)
trail_min_dollars = input.int(1000, "Trail: Min Profit ($)", minval=0, maxval=2000)
trail_pct         = input.float(50, "Trail: Keep % of Peak Profit")
trail_step_pct    = input.float(50, "Trail: Tighten by X% per step")
long_stop = strategy.position_size > 0 ? strategy.position_avg_price - stop_dollars / pv : close - stop_dollars / pv
long_limit = close + tp_dollars / pv
short_stop = strategy.position_size < 0 ? strategy.position_avg_price + stop_dollars / pv : close + stop_dollars / pv
short_limit = close - tp_dollars / pv
if strategy.position_size != 0 and not na(stop_dollars)
    if strategy.openprofit <= -stop_dollars
        strategy.close_all(comment="Open P&L > SL Risk")

// ===== VOLUME PROFILE =====
profile_lookback = input.int(120, "Profile Lookback (bars)", minval=20, maxval=2000, step=10)
profile_rows     = input.int(10, "Price Levels (rows)", minval=5, maxval=100, step=5, tooltip="More rows = finer resolution but slower.")

// ===== DELTA VOLUME =====
min_delta_pct = input.float(7.0, "Min Delta Imbalance (%)", minval=0, maxval=80, step=5, tooltip="Net delta at POC must exceed this % of total POC volume to confirm direction. 0 = disabled.")

// ===== TREND FILTER =====
vwma_len       = input.int(20, "Trend VWMA Length", minval=1)
vwma_slope_len = input.int(5, "VWMA Slope Lookback (bars)", minval=1)
min_slope      = input.float(0.1, "Min VWMA Slope (pts)", minval=0.0, tooltip="0 = disabled.")

// ===== ENTRY =====
confirm_candles = input.int(1, "Confirmation Candles", minval=1, maxval=10, step=1, tooltip="Number of consecutive same-color candles in the trade direction required to confirm entry.")
cooldown_bars   = input.int(10, "Cooldown (bars)", minval=0, maxval=100, step=1)

// ===== SESSION =====
use_session   = input.bool(true, "Use Session Filter")
sess_start_hr = input.int(18, "Session Start Hour (ET)")
sess_start_mn = input.int(0,  "Session Start Minute")
sess_end_hr   = input.int(8,  "Session End Hour (ET)")
sess_end_mn   = input.int(0,  "Session End Minute")


// ===== DAILY LIMITS =====
use_daily_limits  = input.bool(true, "Enable Daily Limits")
daily_loss_limit  = input.float(1000.0, "Daily Loss Limit ($)", minval=0, tooltip="Stop trading for the day after losing this much. 0 = disabled.")
daily_profit_cap  = input.float(2000.0, "Daily Profit Cap ($)", minval=0, tooltip="Stop trading for the day after making this much. 0 = disabled.")

// ===== COMPUTED =====
float stop_pts = stop_dollars / pv
float tp_pts   = tp_dollars / pv

// ===== SESSION LOGIC =====
bar_hr = hour(time, "America/New_York")
bar_mn = minute(time, "America/New_York")
bar_t  = bar_hr * 100 + bar_mn
int s_start = sess_start_hr * 100 + sess_start_mn
int s_end   = sess_end_hr * 100 + sess_end_mn

bool in_session = not use_session or (s_start > s_end ? (bar_t >= s_start or bar_t < s_end) : (bar_t >= s_start and bar_t < s_end))

prev_hr = hour(time[1], "America/New_York")
prev_mn = minute(time[1], "America/New_York")
prev_t  = prev_hr * 100 + prev_mn
bool was_in_session = not use_session or (s_start > s_end ? (prev_t >= s_start or prev_t < s_end) : (prev_t >= s_start and prev_t < s_end))
bool session_ended = was_in_session and not in_session

if session_ended and strategy.position_size != 0
    strategy.close_all(comment="Session Close")

// ===== DAILY P&L =====
var float daily_pnl      = 0.0
var int   daily_trades    = 0
var int   last_reset_day  = -1
var bool  daily_locked    = false

int today = year(time, "America/New_York") * 10000 + month(time, "America/New_York") * 100 + dayofmonth(time, "America/New_York")
if today != last_reset_day
    daily_pnl     := 0.0
    daily_trades  := 0
    daily_locked  := false
    last_reset_day := today

if strategy.closedtrades > 0
    int total_closed = strategy.closedtrades
    float running = 0.0
    for i = 0 to total_closed - 1
        int trade_day = year(strategy.closedtrades.exit_time(i), "America/New_York") * 10000 + month(strategy.closedtrades.exit_time(i), "America/New_York") * 100 + dayofmonth(strategy.closedtrades.exit_time(i), "America/New_York")
        if trade_day == today
            running += strategy.closedtrades.profit(i)
    daily_pnl := running

if use_daily_limits
    if (daily_loss_limit > 0 and daily_pnl <= -daily_loss_limit) or (daily_profit_cap > 0 and daily_pnl >= daily_profit_cap)
        daily_locked := true
        if strategy.position_size != 0
            strategy.close_all(comment="Daily Limit")

// ===== VWMA TREND =====
float vwma_val   = ta.vwma(close, vwma_len)
float vwma_slope = vwma_val - vwma_val[vwma_slope_len]
bool  vwma_up    = min_slope <= 0 or vwma_slope > min_slope
bool  vwma_dn    = min_slope <= 0 or vwma_slope < -min_slope

// ===== VOLUME PROFILE WITH DELTA =====
int lb   = math.min(profile_lookback, bar_index)
int rows = profile_rows

float prof_hi   = ta.highest(high, lb > 0 ? lb : 1)
float prof_lo   = ta.lowest(low, lb > 0 ? lb : 1)
float prof_span = prof_hi - prof_lo
float step_size = prof_span > 0 ? prof_span / rows : na

var array<float> vol_total = array.new_float(100, 0.0)
var array<float> vol_up    = array.new_float(100, 0.0)
var array<float> vol_dn    = array.new_float(100, 0.0)

float poc_price = na
float poc_hi    = na
float poc_lo    = na
float poc_delta_pct = na
int   poc_row   = 0

if not na(step_size) and prof_span > 0 and lb > 1
    for a = 0 to 2
        arr = a == 0 ? vol_total : a == 1 ? vol_up : vol_dn
        if arr.size() != rows
            arr.clear()
            for i = 0 to rows - 1
                arr.push(0.0)
        else
            for i = 0 to rows - 1
                arr.set(i, 0.0)

    for iBar = 0 to lb - 1
        float bar_vol = volume[iBar]
        if bar_vol <= 0
            continue

        float bar_lo  = low[iBar]
        float bar_hi  = high[iBar]
        bool  bar_up  = close[iBar] >= open[iBar]

        int s_row = math.max(math.floor((bar_lo - prof_lo) / step_size), 0)
        int e_row = math.min(math.floor((bar_hi - prof_lo) / step_size), rows - 1)
        int span  = e_row - s_row + 1

        if span <= 0
            continue

        float per_row = bar_vol / span
        for k = 0 to span - 1
            int r = s_row + k
            if r >= 0 and r < rows
                vol_total.set(r, vol_total.get(r) + per_row)
                if bar_up
                    vol_up.set(r, vol_up.get(r) + per_row)
                else
                    vol_dn.set(r, vol_dn.get(r) + per_row)

    // Find POC
    float max_vol = 0.0
    for r = 0 to rows - 1
        float v = vol_total.get(r)
        if v > max_vol
            max_vol := v
            poc_row := r

    poc_price := prof_lo + (poc_row + 0.5) * step_size
    poc_lo    := prof_lo + poc_row * step_size
    poc_hi    := prof_lo + (poc_row + 1) * step_size

    // Delta at POC
    float poc_up  = vol_up.get(poc_row)
    float poc_dn  = vol_dn.get(poc_row)
    float poc_tot = vol_total.get(poc_row)
    poc_delta_pct := poc_tot > 0 ? ((poc_up - poc_dn) / poc_tot) * 100 : 0.0

// ===== BREAKOUT SIGNALS =====
// ===== BREAKOUT DETECTION =====
bool above_poc = not na(poc_hi) and close > poc_hi and close[1] <= poc_hi
bool below_poc = not na(poc_lo) and close < poc_lo and close[1] >= poc_lo

bool delta_bull = min_delta_pct <= 0 or (not na(poc_delta_pct) and poc_delta_pct > min_delta_pct)
bool delta_bear = min_delta_pct <= 0 or (not na(poc_delta_pct) and poc_delta_pct < -min_delta_pct)

// ===== CONFIRMATION: arm on breakout, count same-color candles after =====
var int armed_dir        = 0
var int confirm_count    = 0
var bool reversal_armed  = false

if above_poc and vwma_up and delta_bull
    armed_dir     := 1
    confirm_count := 0
else if below_poc and vwma_dn and delta_bear
    armed_dir     := -1
    confirm_count := 0

if armed_dir == 1
    if close <= poc_lo
        armed_dir     := 0
        confirm_count := 0
    else if close > high[1]
        confirm_count += 1
    else if close < low[1]
        armed_dir     := 0
        confirm_count := 0
else if armed_dir == -1
    if close >= poc_hi
        armed_dir     := 0
        confirm_count := 0
    else if close < low[1]
        confirm_count += 1
    else if close > high[1]
        armed_dir     := 0
        confirm_count := 0

bool confirmed_long  = armed_dir == 1 and confirm_count >= confirm_candles
bool confirmed_short = armed_dir == -1 and confirm_count >= confirm_candles

var int last_trade_bar = -9999
bool cooled_down = bar_index - last_trade_bar >= cooldown_bars

bool long_sig  = confirmed_long and in_session and cooled_down and not daily_locked and strategy.position_size <= 0
bool short_sig = confirmed_short and in_session and cooled_down and not daily_locked and strategy.position_size >= 0

// Reversal Logic
if strategy.closedtrades > 0
    int total_closed = strategy.closedtrades
    if total_closed > 0
        float last_profit = strategy.closedtrades.profit(total_closed - 1)
        if last_profit <= -stop_dollars
            reversal_armed := true

if reversal_armed
    if long_sig
        reversal_armed := false
    else if short_sig
        reversal_armed := false

// ===== ENTRIES: place only entry; exit is placed when IN position using actual fill (avg) =====
// Stop was wrong because it used signal bar close while entry fills at NEXT bar open (gap = wrong distance).
var float current_stop    = 0.0
var float peak_profit_pts = 0.0

float trail_floor_pts = 0.8 * trail_min_dollars / pv

if long_sig
    current_stop    := close - stop_pts
    peak_profit_pts := 0.0
    last_trade_bar  := bar_index
    armed_dir       := 0
    confirm_count   := 0
    strategy.entry("Long", strategy.long)
    strategy.exit("XL", "Long", stop=long_stop, limit=long_limit)
else if short_sig
    current_stop    := close + stop_pts
    peak_profit_pts := 0.0
    last_trade_bar  := bar_index
    armed_dir       := 0
    confirm_count   := 0
    strategy.entry("Short", strategy.short)
    strategy.exit("XS", "Short", stop=short_stop, limit=short_limit)

// ===== EXITS: only when IN position — stop/limit from actual avg so risk is always stop_dollars =====
if strategy.position_size > 0 and not short_sig
    float avg = strategy.position_avg_price
    float hard_stop = avg - stop_pts
    if use_trail
        float profit_now = high - avg
        if profit_now > peak_profit_pts
            peak_profit_pts := profit_now
        if peak_profit_pts >= trail_min_dollars / pv
            float peak_dollars = peak_profit_pts * pv
            int   steps        = math.floor(peak_dollars / trail_step_amt)
            float keep_pct     = math.min(trail_pct + steps * trail_step_pct, 95.0)
            float new_trail    = avg + peak_profit_pts * (keep_pct / 100.0)
            new_trail          := math.max(new_trail, avg + trail_floor_pts)
            if new_trail > current_stop
                current_stop := new_trail
    float effective_stop = math.max(hard_stop, current_stop)
    strategy.exit("XL", "Long", stop=long_stop, limit=long_limit)
else if strategy.position_size < 0 and not long_sig
    float avg = strategy.position_avg_price
    float hard_stop = avg + stop_pts
    if use_trail
        float profit_now = avg - low
        if profit_now > peak_profit_pts
            peak_profit_pts := profit_now
        if peak_profit_pts >= trail_min_dollars / pv
            float peak_dollars = peak_profit_pts * pv
            int   steps        = math.floor(peak_dollars / trail_step_amt)
            float keep_pct     = math.min(trail_pct + steps * trail_step_pct, 95.0)
            float new_trail    = avg - peak_profit_pts * (keep_pct / 100.0)
            new_trail          := math.min(new_trail, avg - trail_floor_pts)
            if new_trail < current_stop
                current_stop := new_trail
    float effective_stop = math.min(hard_stop, current_stop)
    strategy.exit("XS", "Short", stop=short_stop, limit=short_limit)

// ===== PLOT =====
plot(vwma_val, "VWMA", vwma_up ? color.lime : vwma_dn ? color.red : color.gray, linewidth=2)
plot(not na(poc_price) ? poc_price : na, "POC", color.yellow, style=plot.style_stepline, linewidth=1)
plot(not na(poc_hi) ? poc_hi : na, "POC High", #2962FF, style=plot.style_stepline, linewidth=2)
plot(not na(poc_lo) ? poc_lo : na, "POC Low", #2962FF, style=plot.style_stepline, linewidth=2)
plot(strategy.position_size != 0 ? current_stop : na, "Stop", color.fuchsia, style=plot.style_stepline, linewidth=2)

bgcolor(not na(poc_hi) and not na(poc_lo) and close >= poc_lo and close <= poc_hi ? color.new(#2962FF, 90) : na)

plotshape(long_sig, "Long Signal", shape.triangleup, location.belowbar, color.lime, size=size.small)
plotshape(short_sig, "Short Signal", shape.triangledown, location.abovebar, color.red, size=size.small)

plot(not na(poc_delta_pct) ? poc_delta_pct : na, "POC Delta %", color.orange, display=display.data_window)
plot(daily_pnl, "Daily P&L", daily_pnl >= 0 ? color.lime : color.red, display=display.data_window)
bgcolor(daily_locked ? color.new(color.red, 85) : na)
